verdict.rationale: telli documents a REST API with a published OpenAPI spec for managing contacts, scheduling calls and importing phone numbers, plus an MCP server that exposes Charlie, the assistant that builds agents, automates workflows and analyzes calls. That gives programmatic reach into a meaningful part of the product, but nothing documents that the API matches the UI. Many UI-documented features, such as the agent builder, test calls, voice cloning, data retention and live monitoring, have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented endpoints for agent building, workflows, analytics and settings, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
